PcoMed will not charge *** Run Fees for reasonable quantities, not to exceed *** units or four *** Runs, of Treated Integra Products or Partially Treated Integra Product and test samples required to complete US Marketing Clearance and/or EU Marketing Clearance testing and validations.

NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION IS INTENDED TO LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR BREACHES OF SECTION 3.1 (GRANT OF RIGHTS), SECTION 5 (CONFIDENTIALITY PROVISIONS), OR SECTIONS 8.1 AND 8.2 (OWNERSHIP AND LICENSE).
findings.explanation: This carve-out strips away limitation of liability protections for major operational areas like IP ownership, confidentiality, and grant of rights, exposing [PARTY_B] to potentially catastrophic, uncapped damages.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the broad carve-outs from the limitation of liability clause, and subject all claims to a mutual, reasonable aggregate liability cap.

findings.quoted_text: Integra shall have no liability at any time to [PARTY_B] for Integra's failure to pay the Minimum Payment. In the event that Integra fails to satisfy the Minimum Payment for any Minimum Payment Period, [PARTY_B] may, at its sole election, give notice, as set forth in Section 3.2, for conversion of Integra's exclusive arrangement under Section 3.1 to a non-exclusive arrangement. [PARTY_B]'s conversion right is [PARTY_B]'s sole and exclusive remedy for Integra's failure to satisfy the Minimum Payment for any Minimum Payment Period.
findings.explanation: If Integra fails to reach the agreed minimum payment thresholds, [PARTY_B] cannot sue for the unpaid balance and is forced to accept conversion to non-exclusive as the sole remedy, resulting in unrecoverable financial loss.
findings.suggested_change: Permit [PARTY_B] to recover the financial shortfall of the Minimum Payment directly as damages or payment owed, rather than making conversion the exclusive remedy.

findings.quoted_text: [PARTY_B] will not charge *** Run Fees for reasonable quantities, not to exceed *** units or four *** Runs, of Treated Integra Products or Partially Treated Integra Product and test samples required to complete US Marketing Clearance and/or EU Marketing Clearance testing and validations.
findings.explanation: [PARTY_B] is required to provide uncompensated runs and units for regulatory testing and validations, which can lead to scope creep if regulatory bodies demand extended testing beyond the initial estimates.
findings.suggested_change: Clearly define the maximum hard limit of free units and runs, and specify that any additional testing or units requested by Integra or regulators will be billed at [PARTY_B]'s standard rates.

findings.quoted_text: [PARTY_B] shall indemnify and defend Integra and its Affiliates... from and against any and all claims... for (iii) product defects or liability associated with the [PARTY_B] Surface Modification Technology.
findings.explanation: [PARTY_B] provides a broad indemnification for product defects related to its technology without any limitation, financial cap, or exclusion for Integra's own handling, manufacturing, or misuse of the products.
findings.suggested_change: Add a liability cap to the indemnification obligations and exclude claims arising from Integra's improper handling, modification, or use of the products.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of updates before we proceed. - In the relevant clause, the current terms remove liability protections for key operational areas, leaving [PARTY_B] exposed to uncapped damages; we propose removing these broad carve-outs and applying a mutual aggregate liability cap. - In the relevant clause, [PARTY_B] is required to supply uncompensated items for regulatory testing, which risks scope creep; we propose establishing a strict limit for free units and billing any extra testing at standard rates. Thank you and best regards,
